name: Adriana
description: The stripped captain of the guard of Paliano who carries Brago's sword and calls on the citizens to defy the usurper queen.

timeline.summary: Adriana stands guard as King Brago, now a paranoid ghost, meets with two Custodi ghosts in the great dining hall.
timeline.quote: King Brago sat at the head of his dining room table before a clean plate and sparkling silverware

timeline.summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
timeline.quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

timeline.summary: The Custodi bless Adriana with a formal goodbye before leaving.
timeline.quote: Adriana received the blessing willingly

timeline.summary: Adriana finds a servant girl throwing out the crown's plates because Her Ladyship dislikes them, hinting at a coming queen.
timeline.quote: Boss told us that Her Ladyship didn't like the plates,

timeline.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
timeline.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

timeline.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
timeline.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

timeline.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
timeline.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

timeline.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
timeline.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

timeline.summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
timeline.quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
timeline.quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

timeline.summary: Adriana takes up Brago's sword, deciding it is safest in her hands.
timeline.quote: Adriana's fingers grazed the hilt of Brago's sword.

timeline.summary: Adriana finds her guard shares her confusion and rage about the coup.
timeline.quote: Adriana was relieved to find all of them as deep in the dark as she was.

timeline.summary: Adriana realizes the coup took bribes to the Custodi, payment to the staff and to the assassin.
timeline.quote: Bribes to pay off the Custodi.

timeline.summary: Adriana confronts Marchesa about right of succession, and Marchesa says the Custodi accepted a legal will naming her heir.
timeline.quote: But the Custodi was very willing to accept properly filed legal documents.

timeline.summary: Marchesa reveals she dealt with Brago's descendants so that her name was next in succession.
timeline.quote: I dealt with them a while ago, however, and it just so happened that my name was next in the line of succession.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
timeline.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

timeline.summary: Marchesa offers Adriana a black-rose breastplate; Adriana refuses.
timeline.quote: You already know I'm not putting that on.

timeline.summary: Marchesa says that if the people call her a tyrant she will be tyrannical.
timeline.quote: Then I will be tyrannical

timeline.summary: Adriana spits in Marchesa's face and leaves with the breastplate.
timeline.quote: Adriana spat in the Queen's face.

timeline.summary: Adriana rides through the city dragging the rose breastplate behind her horse.
timeline.quote: tied the dreadful rose-adorned breastplate to a rope

timeline.summary: Marchesa publicly announces that the former captain has retired with a pension.
timeline.quote: The former captain has retired, with thanks from our fair city

timeline.summary: Adriana speaks to the crowd in the Thieves' Quarter, calling Marchesa's rule illegitimate and urging the people not to bow to her flag.
timeline.quote: Marchesa would have you stand with her, in service to a true crown resting upon a false head

timeline.summary: Members of Brago's guard secretly break their oaths to patrol the streets and protect citizens.
timeline.quote: Those who served in Brago's guard broke their oaths to the crown under cover of darkness

timeline.summary: Months later Adriana visits the elven explorer Selvala at her home.
timeline.quote: The elven explorer Selvala stood on the other side of the door

timeline.summary: Adriana proposes that Selvala serve as senator to halt Paliano's murderous monarchy.
timeline.quote: the finest nominee for a senator I can think of.

timeline.summary: Adriana asks Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
timeline.quote: Will you help us build the Republic of Paliano?

timeline.summary: Adriana tells the citizens they awoke as unwitting traitors under the banner of a usurper queen, Marchesa.
timeline.quote: You awoke as unwitting traitors beneath the bloodstained banner of a usurper queen

timeline.summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering King Brago and forging his will and of commanding the Custodi.
timeline.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

timeline.summary: Adriana notes that the City Troops' banners have changed and that Marchesa avoids the city's symbol.
timeline.quote: But the banners of the City Troops have already changed.

timeline.summary: Adriana declares she carries Brago's sword and, though stripped of her title, will not relinquish her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
timeline.quote: I know this because I now carry that sword

timeline.summary: Adriana urges the citizens to stand with her and Brago and disobey the pretender.
timeline.quote: stand with me, and with Brago, and show your loyalty to your city through your disobedience to the pretender.

timeline.summary: Leovold observes that Adriana barely survived the queen's ascension and expects emissaries to keep pressing her.
timeline.quote: She has only narrowly survived the queen's ascension

timeline.summary: Adriana rejects Leovold's overture; his messenger returns with a broken nose.
timeline.quote: the messenger returned with a broken nose and a completely ruined shirt.

timeline.summary: Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
timeline.quote: He has twice now taken advantage of large gatherings assembled by Captain Adriana

timeline.summary: Leovold reports that Marchesa has replaced the city guard with loyal spies and assassins as she prepares to confront Adriana.
timeline.quote: The city guard has been largely thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa

timeline.summary: Adriana stages prison breaks to bring her former guards back to her side while Grenzo abdicates his post.
timeline.quote: Adriana has managed to stage some rather daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

relations.note: She is his captain of the guard until his death.
relations.quote: a post that puts her in the service of the ghost king, Brago

relations.note: She rejects Marchesa's usurpation and rallies the city against her.
relations.quote: Our city will not turn over to you so easily.

relations.note: Adriana vows to unseat the usurper.
relations.quote: I have no wish to rule, only to unseat the usurper

relations.note: The queen gears up to confront the renegade captain.
relations.quote: as she gears up to confront the renegade Captain Adriana

pages_say.description: The captain of the guard of the High City of Paliano, who serves the ghost king Brago, then turns against Queen Marchesa and proposes a republic.
The stripped captain of the guard of Paliano who carries Brago's sword and calls on the citizens to defy the usurper queen.
The former captain of the guard, a righteous rebel whose rallies and prison breaks cause unrest against Marchesa.
